mapper.insert: INSERT INTO datasource_industry_mapping (datasource_id, industry_code, priority) VALUES (#{datasourceId}, #{industryCode}, #{priority}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE industry_code = VALUES(industry_code), priority = VALUES(priority)
mapper.select: SELECT business_category FROM datasource_config WHERE id = #{datasourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO concept_relation (industry_code, source_concept_key, target_concept_key) VALUES (#{industryCode}, #{sourceConcept}, #{targetConcept})

INSERT INTO industry_concept (industry_code, concept_type, concept_key, concept_aliases, description, source, status) VALUES (#{industryCode}, 'metric', #{conceptKey}, #{aliases}, #{description}, 'user_feedback', 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE concept_aliases = CONCAT(IFNULL(concept_aliases, ''), '/', #{aliasToAdd})
mapper.select: SELECT concept_type, concept_key, concept_aliases FROM industry_concept WHERE industry_code = #{industryCode} AND status = 'approved' AND concept_type IN ('entity', 'metric') ORDER BY FIELD(concept_type, 'metric', 'entity'), concept_key
SELECT industry_code, industry_name FROM industry_template WHERE industry_code = #{industryCode} AND is_active = 1
SELECT concept_type, concept_key, concept_aliases, description FROM industry_concept WHERE industry_code = #{industryCode} AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY usage_count DESC, confidence DESC
